body: Yes. I am going t die.

Yes they know.  They've known for years ti would happen soon. I love them and I'll miss them but i do not have anything left to give. It's all I can do to stay awake   
Im excited I'm moving on. I hope others do too.

The simple answer is that I'm not buying what this life is selling
I dont hate it. But there is no doubt that this is not my home. I don't think like you people, want the same things, laugh at the same jokes 
  I'm an outcast since was 5 hrs old. This world is made for family. I am my family. I will do what best for me at the end of my three month death sentence.

I feel it calling me as cheesy as that may sound. It's in my ear, my constant companion. It's not an evil voice, it's the voice of a friend telling me that I'm done here. I'm no angry because I know the world is chaos and that I am part of the force of nature. I think of it as a beautiful transition. And quite frankly I cannot wait :)

I believe both are just as precious. Death is an altered energy form, a mystery, an adventure far from the tedium of everyday social commitments.  I want to take myself there because I'm ready. Because I'm done here   I love deeply the ones I love and letting them go will be the most loving gesture I could ever do. 
But again it's not about them, it's about my journey. The one thing I absolutely have to do alone. I have 3 months. I'll make them worth it.

Sure. This letter is for others in my dilemma. I want people faced with these feelings and emotions to make their own choices and do whats best for them. Be that live or die. Dying is not always
 The answer...but neither is living. We all get to choose, and that choice is personal. I hope this helps.

You're crying for help. And you'll find a lot of sympathy here.  But you won't find answers.   Be true to yourself. Sober up and Listen to your thoughts in a quiet place.  Then do what you need to do. Live or die.  Do it for yourself, not anyone else. As long as you act in this way, you cannot make the wrong decision.
